**Phase 1: Worktree Setup & Dependency Configuration**
1. Create an isolated git worktree in `.worktrees/vitepress-assets-shards` and switch into it.
2. Update VitePress catalog dependency specifier in [pnpm-workspace.yaml](pnpm-workspace.yaml#L95) to `https://pkg.pr.new/vitepress@5432` and run `vp install`.
3. Add `assetsShards: 4` to top-level `defineConfig({ ... })` in [docs/.vitepress/config.ts](docs/.vitepress/config.ts#L755).
4. Commit initial setup using Conventional Commits (`feat(docs): update vitepress to pkg.pr.new/vitepress@5432 and configure assetsShards`).

**Phase 2: Build, Shard & Locale Testing**
5. Run single-pass full site build using `vp run docs:build:all` to produce single `.vitepress/dist` output.
6. Measure file distribution across generated `assets/` shard directories (`assets/0`, `assets/1`, `assets/2`, `assets/3`) to verify no individual folder exceeds ~20,000 files.
7. Run multi-locale build script [docs/scripts/build-locales.ts](docs/scripts/build-locales.ts) to verify whether locale-scoped staging and merging into `.vitepress/dist` continues to work cleanly with sharded assets.

**Phase 3: Quality Standards & Verification**
8. Run test coverage checks (`vp test --coverage`) as the final test step to regenerate coverage reports.
9. Verify TypeDoc API builds (`vp run docs:api`) and markdown/docstring linting.
10. Verify asset URL resolutions in generated HTML and JS chunks via `vp run docs:preview`.

- [pnpm-workspace.yaml](pnpm-workspace.yaml#L95) — Update `vitepress` catalog version to `https://pkg.pr.new/vitepress@5432`.
